arts.ttl: Estevão celebrates ‘perfect night’ after goal in Chelsea’s win over Barcelona in Champions League
arts.sum: The beautiful strike gave Chelsea its second goal in a 3-0 win over the Spanish powerhouse Barcelona in the Champions League on Tuesday. With his family watching from the stands, Chelsea teenage sensation Estevão made a run through the right side of the area and sped past two Barcelona defenders before firing a powerful angled shot into the net.

arts.ttl: Why is Pedri not playing for Barcelona against Chelsea in the Champions League?
arts.sum: Pedri had played every game of the season until injury struck him against Real Madrid, but his presence for the Chelsea clash was ruled out when he did not take part in Monday’s training session before departing for the UK. Barcelona will be without Pedri for their game in the Champions League against Premier League side Chelsea, as the midfielder deals with an injury.

arts.ttl: Enzo Maresca plays down Chelsea’s Champions League dismantling of Barcelona
arts.sum: The Blues beat 10-man Barca 3-0, with Estevao comprehensively outshining fellow 18-year-old Lamine Yamal.

arts.ttl: Maresca reveals one thing Chelsea did to make Barcelona 'feel uncomfortable' in dominant CL win
arts.sum: Enzo Maresca reveals one specific tactic that Chelsea used to make Barcelona 'feel uncomfortable' in their dominant 3-0 victory in the Champions League on Tuesday night.

arts.ttl: Beating of Barca: Chelsea join exclusive UCL club and set new record in dominant win
arts.sum: Chelsea join an exclusive Champions League club and set a new club record in Tuesday's 3-0 win over Barcelona at Stamford Bridge.

arts.ttl: Wayne Rooney makes huge claim about Chelsea’s Marc Cucurella after Champions League win over Barcelona
arts.sum: Barcelona had scored in 53 successive matches before being shut out by Chelsea

arts.ttl: Barcelona boss issues clear Marcus Rashford message after Man Utd star benched vs Chelsea
arts.sum: Marcus Rashford was named on the subs bench for Barcelona's Champions League clash vs Chelsea - with Hansi Flick explaining that decision before the match.

arts.ttl: Wayne Rooney hails 'absolutely incredible' Chelsea star after 'best performance I've seen in a long, long time' in win over Barcelona - as England legend sends message to Lamine Yamal
arts.sum: Wayne Rooney hailed the Blues star as 'absolutely incredible' after Chelsea 's 3-0 Champions League demolition of Barcelona at Stamford Bridge.

arts.ttl: Chelsea teenager Estevao revels in the 'best moment of my career so far' after scoring in 3-0 triumph over Barcelona - and upstaging Lamine Yamal in battle of wonderkids: 'The PERFECT night'
arts.sum: KIERAN GILL AT STAMFORD BRIDGE: Estevao described blowing away Barcelona as the 'perfect night' as his solo goal saw the Brazilian upstage his fellow teenage superstar Lamine Yamal.

arts.ttl: Estevao responds after Chelsea fans make feelings clear with X-rated Lamine Yamal chants
arts.sum: Chelsea starlet Estevao scored as the Blues thrashed Barcelona 3-0 in the Champions League, with the Brazilian teenager praising the supporters after his standout display at Stamford Bridge
